items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So we wound up in the picture, but that's when I first met Jacobi.

ctx.x: called in because I was new on the scene. They had some Billy Rose -- girl from the Billy Rose cabaret on the cover, and it was a montage.
And Jacobi and Jenny Daniels had just got off the boat more or less. So we wound up in the picture, but that's when I first met Jacobi.
And when he opened Le Ruban Bleu, he opened with Herman Chittison, Dave Barbour, and Cedric Wallace on bass.
